f7e51be13d: The Myrtis Jackson mural honors Myrtis Lucille Jackson (1923-2020), a beloved matriarch tragically killed by a family member in Auburn Gresham just months shy of her 97th birthday. Moved by the loss, Jacqueline Xavier, former owner of M2M Gifts, partnered with Myrtis' great-grandson, Zavion Neely, and local artists to create a mural celebrating her life. Completed with The Simple Good and lead artist Corbin DeShazo, the mural was unveiled on Myrtis’ 97th birthday, October 28, 2020, during Domestic Violence Awareness Month.
3701a7d85d: This 26 x 15 ft. outdoor mural located in the Lakeview neighborhood in Chicago was executed with the intent to kindle a sense of vibrancy, to beautify a seemingly ordinary neighborhood and to re-emulate the subliminal affects from nature, spirit and empathy. (from artist)
3e362aaa3d: (Photo Credit: Sandra Steinbrecher) "The Seeds We Plant Today Determine Our Growth For Tomorrow” mural highlights the work of Dolores Huerta in her role as an activist for human rights, additionally her strength and persistence as the only woman in a male dominated field. The power fist is a symbol seen in movements for marginalized people throughout history. Further symbolism is reflected in the sun which connects to the roots with the rising fists of the work of our ancestors. It is my duty to create work that makes women more visible, in content and process. My team is made up of strong female artists of color, so when people see us painting this work the message comes full circle and together we change minds. Women of Color must be seen more often as the strong, nurturing leaders that we are.
